history.body: Hi, I saw Pearl Residences advertised. We’re looking for a place to stay ourselves—could you share roughly where it is and the starting price?

Pearl Residences is in Seberang Jaya on Penang mainland, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall. The starting reference is around RM302k after the 14 August package rebate for eligible categories; that’s based on the listed base price, not a guaranteed all-in quote, as parking and add-ons vary. The units are 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Does that layout suit what you have in mind for your own stay?
Three bedrooms sounds useful, and 900 sq. ft. could work for us. We’re still comparing the commute and overall costs, though, so I’d want to see the floor plan before deciding if the layout suits us.

That makes sense—the floor plan should help you judge whether 900 sq. ft. works for you. The concept shows an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a balcony and a small storage area. For ongoing costs, the stated maintenance is RM0.18 per sq. ft. including sinking fund, or about RM162/month for 900 sq. ft. (excluding utilities and other costs). I’ll get the approved floor plan for you. Where do you usually commute to? That’ll help us assess whether Seberang Jaya suits your route.

Thanks, that’s useful, especially the maintenance estimate. We commute toward George Town a few days a week, so we’ll need to check how the location works for us. The layout concept sounds reasonable, but we’ll wait to see the approved plan before judging the space.

That’s a sensible commute to check. Seberang Jaya has connectivity toward Butterworth and the wider mainland road network, but I don’t have a verified George Town drive time, so I wouldn’t want to guess. Once you’ve had a chance to review the approved plan, you can judge whether the layout works and test your usual weekday route before deciding on a visit.
